articles.summary: RingCentral AI Receptionist (AIR) wins ICMI Best New Technology Solution UC Today names RingCentral Best Integrated UC Solution BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc . (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced two industry awards recognizing its innovation in helping businesses serve customers, empower employees, and capture more opportunities. RingCentral AI Receptionist ™ (AIR) won Best New Technology Solution at the 2026 ICMI Contact Center Expo , while UC Today named RingCentral Best Integrated UC Solution. “Voice is the most natural way customers reach businesses, and they expect the conversation to keep moving, context intact, with a person there when they need one,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO, RingCentral. “Our platform brings AI and human agents together across the full conversation lifecycle, with humans in the loop. Businesses deliver better customer experiences, give employees time back, and capture more opportunities. These awards recognize that impact.” “Strong customer engagement starts with integrated technology,” said Rob Scott, Publisher, UC Today. “RingCentral winning Best Integrated Solution at the UC Today Awards shows what happens when every capability works as one: seamless for teams, connected for customers. Congratulations to everyone at RingCentral.” Growing adoption. Measurable impact. The awards come as adoption of RingCentral’s AI portfolio accelerates. In the third quarter of 2026 , annual recurring revenue (ARR) from customers using at least one native paid AI product now represents approximately 15% of total ARR or over $400 million, doubling year over year. AI Receptionist, or AIR, now has more than 22,000 customers, up nearly 4x year over year. AIR makes sure businesses never miss a call, turning every call into an opportunity by answering questions, capturing leads, booking appointments, and routing callers with context intact. It’s easy to deploy and works with existing phone systems. The UC Today award recognizes the broader strength of RingCentral’s integrated approach: AI that automates interactions, assists employees, and analyzes conversations. Together, these capabilities form a connected flywheel across customer and employee communications, turning insights into action to make every conversation smarter. Helping customers handle more and achieve more At Cartelligent , RingCentral’s AI suite helps employees spend less time on manual work and more time converting leads into customers. “RingCentral’s AI suite has transformed our operations, allowing us to connect with 100% of live leads during business hours and move toward an 85% lead-to-signup target,” said Jessica Carstens, VP of Operations at Cartelligent. “With automated coaching and AI-generated summaries, we’ve replaced manual ‘busy work’ with strategic growth, all while maintaining an elite 9.85/10 customer satisfaction score.” At JTR Insurance Agency , RingCentral AIR cuts call routing from minutes to seconds, freeing employees to serve clients and saving on operational costs. "Before AIR, it took an average of 5 minutes just to route a call. Now, it takes only 24 seconds,” said Todd Stanley, Owner of JTR Insurance Agency. “By letting AIR completely automate the handling of daily calls, our team no longer has to waste valuable hours manually answering and transferring them. That massive boost in efficiency gives us a 91% time savings and slashes our monthly operational costs." To learn more about RingCentral and its Agentic Voice AI portfolio, visit ringcentral.com . articles.summary: Report cites RingCentral’s agentic voice AI, established communications infrastructure, and deep healthcare expertise BELMONT, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- RingCentral, Inc . (NYSE: RNG), a global leader in AI-powered customer engagement, today announced it has been named a Visionary Leader by Frost & Sullivan in the Frost Radar™: Conversational AI in Patient Engagement in North America, 2026 . The report highlights how integrated conversational AI can improve patient access, reduce administrative workloads, and enable more seamless coordination between automated workflows and human care teams. RingCentral is recognized for its agentic voice AI platform, established communications infrastructure, and healthcare-specific capabilities as key differentiators. “Healthcare organizations need AI that takes action, automating workflows, assisting care teams in live patient conversations, and analyzing every interaction to make the next one better,” said Kira Makagon, President & COO of RingCentral. “This recognition reflects how our complete customer engagement platform improves patient access, streamlines operations, and delivers better experiences across the patient journey.” The report identifies RingCentral's ability to deliver these AI capabilities through an established communications platform spanning voice, SMS, messaging, video, contact center, digital channels, and APIs. Frost & Sullivan highlights several strengths that differentiate RingCentral's approach to Agentic Voice AI in healthcare, including: One platform from first call to follow-up. RingCentral AI Receptionist™ (AIR), RingCentral AIR Pro™, AI Virtual Assistant (RingCentral AVA™) and AI Conversation Expert (RingCentral ACE™) automate patient interactions, assist care teams with contextual insights, and analyze conversations for quality, compliance, sentiment, and emerging patient needs. Purpose-built healthcare workflows. AIR Pro for Healthcare offers accelerators and best-practice starter kits for identity verification, scheduling, wait-list management, eligibility checks, prescription refills, billing, and digital intake, so organizations can automate without extensive programming. Flexible integration and deployment. With 80 EHR integrations and 600+ integrations across the RingCentral product portfolio, providers can add AI to existing telephony, EHR, and contact center systems without replacing them. Established scale and healthcare expertise. RingCentral supports over 600,000 customers worldwide, including numerous healthcare organizations, such as hospitals, integrated delivery networks, clinics, behavioral health facilities, long-term care providers, and payers. “As conversational AI evolves from individual virtual assistants into an enterprise engagement layer, RingCentral stands out for pairing agentic voice AI with a mature communications foundation,” said Alejandra María Parra, Senior Research Analyst, Healthcare IT, Frost & Sullivan. “This approach enables healthcare organizations to connect automated interactions with human care teams, preserve context across touchpoints, and introduce AI capabilities while continuing to operate existing healthcare systems.” “To deliver on our commitment to easy, modern eye care across our 320+ locations, consistent quality is everything,” said Keyner Bonilla, Telecom Specialist, Now Optics. “RingCentral AI Conversation Expert (ACE) is the primary tool our QA team relies on to analyze interactions between patients and store support. Auditing 90–95% of our 184,000+ monthly calls give us the real-time insights needed to continuously elevate customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.” A benchmarking system that evaluates companies on a Growth Index and an Innovation Index, The Frost Radar™ considers factors including revenue, speed of innovation, platform breadth, funding activity, and new partnership and customer announcements. Out of 100 qualified participants in the Frost Radar, only 13 were selected as leaders. RingCentral earned an Innovation Score of 3.80 and a Growth Score of 3.95 out of 4. Frost & Sullivan also notes RingCentral's over $250 million in annual R&D investment, with majority allocated to new products and initiatives, including agentic voice AI and healthcare capabilities.
